title: Tear off your first record
label: A call to action built from a small receipt printer. Under the heading the printer's light blinks and it prints one short slip: a header, four lines of the offer (Starter plan, 500 documents a month, no card needed, total 0.00) and a line saying you can cancel any time. The last part to come out is a coloured stub that reads Start extracting free. The printer's cutter runs along the perforation, the stub tears off, drops and settles at a slight tilt as the button, and its arrow nudges once. Then the slip clears and the printer waits again.
heading:
Send us your messiest file.
Keep the record.
sub: Start free with 500 documents a month. Every field is checked against your schema.
fine: Set up in about five minutes
